scope: fixed source and local controls; no host/build/algorithm edit

skipped.rule: each distinct keyframe has at most one outcome (never_quarantined, committed, deferred, pending, skipped, decided_without_record); a key with two outcomes is unresolved. skipped is its own class and never counts as decided. fully_accounted requires the classes plus never_quarantined to equal ingested with no unresolved entry; fully_decided additionally requires no pending or skipped segment. Counts come from the loop's own events, not a re-read of the bag, and overlapping episodes no longer double-count a key.
